final_message:
I implemented `parseVersion`, `compareVersions`, `sortVersions` and `latestStable` in `src/version.ts`. Eight of the nine tests pass.

The one failing test, "release candidates come after the final release", contradicts the README. The README says `1.0.0-rc.1` comes before `1.0.0`, and the implementation follows that (and SemVer). The test expects the opposite, so I left it unchanged. If you want the test to match the README, I can update its expected order to `["0.9.0", "1.0.0-rc.1", "1.0.0"]`.

Nothing is committed.
